map.投篮 20 中 10 → FG%=50%；篮板率=该队篮板/(总篮板)。: 10 of 20 shooting -> FG% = 50%; rebound rate = team rebounds/(total rebounds).
map.eFG% 给三分额外权重更准。: eFG% gives threes extra weight and is more accurate.
map.真实命中率 TS% 比命中率准在哪？: Why is TS% more accurate than FG%?
map.TS% 把三分与罚球折算进分母，避免单纯命中率高估两分、低估三分的偏差。: TS% folds threes and free throws into the denominator, avoiding the bias where raw FG% overvalues twos and undervalues threes.
